nodes.text: Tickets for a show cost $7 each. Zoe buys 6 tickets and pays with $50. How much change does she get?

design.purpose: Solve two-step problems with the four operations.
design.rationale: The first problem splits the two steps into parts. The other two ask a single question, so students find the hidden first step on their own. 3.OA.D.8 asks for exactly this kind of problem, with whole numbers and an unknown quantity.
misconceptions: Subtracting the price of one ticket from $50 instead of the cost of all six.
references: Common Core Standards Writing Team (2011), Progressions for the Common Core State Standards in Mathematics, K, Counting and Cardinality; K-5, Operations and Algebraic Thinking
